name: Alberta
description: Mostly Interior Plains – semi-arid prairie in the south-east, aspen parkland in the centre, boreal forest to the north – rising westward through foothills to the Rocky Mountains (Banff, Jasper, Kananaskis). A sliver of Canadian Shield in the far north-east. Calgary sits at the foothills edge east of the Rockies; Edmonton is in the parkland.
